steps: Record exact matching server/client pins and installed payload hashes
Verify adorablehamsterpets, animalgarden_sugarglider, aquarius_libs and patchouli in native registry/startup
Verify effective server main/worldgen config and sync; no missing-dependency, config, mixin or packet errors
Confirm Paxi loaded the exact native glider modifier replacement with one spawn entry, weight2/group1
Use real pets in the qualified habitat with existing Critters and Companions, Naturalist, cats, Doggy Talents and current normal animal AI
Observe tame/breed/follow/sit/wander, daytime hamster bed sleep, grooming and shoulder idle
Observe glider climb and actual glide between branches and accessible elevated shelter; inspect wall/roof/door containment
Check pickup/petting/mount/dismount with Smooth Player Animations and Cinematic Interactions; no optional animation mod is required or added
Check ordinary walking, workstation and inventory input/animation with pets on and off shoulders
Press the actual throw key with a mounted pet and confirm server refuses without entity/projectile loss
Verify own-hamster accidental hit protection and normal owner-authorized recovery, not generic invulnerability
Verify fever, crop snacking, theft and hide-and-seek remain disabled
Breed only the bounded consenting-owner test pair: one baby, inherited owner, cooldown and configured per-player limit; retain every resulting pet in the count
No kill/destructive pet recovery test in an official save: only master-authorized disposable test pets/window, with exact before/after UUID and bed-link receipts
KG and Sera tame distinct pets through normal gameplay; verify each owner, other-player interaction limits, name and behavior
Record UUIDs, owner UUIDs, age/variant, beds/home/behavior, inventories and nearby counts
Exercise ordinary disconnect/reconnect and owner travel/teleport rescue without losing or duplicating pets
Normal save/stop/start in the master window; compare identities/data/counts and bed/home links afterward
If native bed recovery occurs, reconcile its observed new UUID with the existing managed slot before any new admission
Use the same candidate/config, observation duration, loaded area and player activity for paired baseline and pet measurements
Measure loaded/ticking entities by type, loaded chunks, server CPU/RAM/GC and real mean/p95 MSPT/TPS with current native performance tooling
Compare at four initial pets, then at most eight managed pets only if the master admits that ramp
Observe natural spawn samples in the actual forest/plains biome pool; weight is not a promised density or cap
Keep client frame-time/animation observations separate from server performance; retain spikes/failures and tune only from measured causes
No permanent chunk loaders, automatic respawn/refill, NoAI conversion or entity culling to manufacture a pass
Master fits and verifies the homestead hamster habitat and south-shore glider sanctuary around preserved existing terrain, paths and structures
Verify exact body/flight/support/BE states and eye-level visual quality before admitting real entities
Admit two real hamsters and two real gliders with stable managed slot records; owners tame/link beds normally
Record world/save/checkpoint identity, actual entity UUIDs and counts, native restart and visual receipts
Official permanent-world integration remains separate until the master completes its controlled promotion; never replace or relabel the save

boundary: Existing glider installed hashes/startup listing and static dependency/config checks are separate receipts. All requested actual gameplay, mixed-mod, multiplayer, performance and permanent-world tests above remain unperformed by the pets specialist.
